## Declarations

### ImageSource

Interface. `import type { ImageSource } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/image";`

```ts
export interface ImageSource {
    src: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    sources: {
        type: string;
        srcset: string;
    }[];
}
```

What `import x from "./x.jpg?image"` gives: the file's size and its generated variants.

Members:

- `src`: The `<img src>`: the largest fallback variant.
- `width`: Intrinsic size from the file (0 for formats that aren't decoded, like SVG).
- `height`: Intrinsic height (0 when `width` is).
- `sources`: AVIF first, the original format last (the `<img>`'s own srcset).

Used by: [`ImageProps`](#imageprops).

### ImageProps

Type. `import type { ImageProps } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/image";`

```ts
export type ImageProps = Omit<JSX.IntrinsicElements["img"], "src" | "srcset" | "alt" | "sizes" | "width" | "height" | "loading" | "decoding"> & {
    src: ImageSource | string;
    alt: string;
    sizes?: string;
    width?: number;
    height?: number;
    loading?: "lazy" | "eager";
    decoding?: "async" | "sync" | "auto";
};
```

Props of [`Image`](#image). Every other `<img>` attribute (`class`, `id`, `style`, `fetchpriority`,
event handlers, ...) is passed through to the rendered `<img>`. `JSX.IntrinsicElements["img"]`
is the `<img>` props type in both preact 10 and 11 (preact 11 has no `JSX.HTMLAttributes`).

Documented members:

- `src`: A `?image` import (local, or a remote URL that `images.remotePatterns` allows, fetched at
  build time), or a plain URL string: rendered as a bare `<img>`, not optimized (set width /
  height yourself).
- `alt`: Required; use "" for a decorative image.
- `sizes`: Defaults to `(min-width: <width>px) <width>px, 100vw`.
- `width`: Rendered width; height follows the aspect ratio unless given. Defaults to the file's.
- `height`: Rendered height. Defaults to `width` times the file's aspect ratio.
- `loading`: Defaults to "lazy"; use "eager" (and fetchpriority="high") for the page's main image.
- `decoding`: Defaults to "async".

Uses: [`ImageSource`](#imagesource).

### Image

Component. `import { Image } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/image";`

```ts
export function Image(props: ImageProps): JSX.Element;
```

A responsive `<picture>` (AVIF, then the original format) with no layout shift, for a `?image`
import. Works in pages, layouts and islands. Throws without `alt`.

Example:

```tsx
import hero from "./hero.jpg?image";
<Image src={hero} alt="" loading="eager" />
```

Uses: [`ImageProps`](#imageprops).
